notes.title: Updating Your In-Flight Experience
notes.content:
Hello Friskers!

We're putting out a few updates this fine evening that should fix quite a few issues that I'm sure you all have been experiencing.

   -No more disappearing passengers! I know going through the TSA can be dreaded but that doesn't mean you can avoid it by simply not existing! The passengers should no longer pop out of existence.

   -My wand scanner is not a claymore! You can no longer two hand the wand scanner, this should fix the issue of accidentally grabbing the wand scanner while trying to frisk contraband.

   -New TSA-approved rubber gloves! We've implemented new hand models and animations to better match the TSA aesthetic.

   -Gloves of gold! If you finish every shift with a gold trophy then you'll be rewarded with flashy gold gloves that you can brag about to your TSA co-friskers.

   -Stop casting those waiting passengers into the shadow realm! You can no longer no-stamp passengers that are still waiting in-line. This caused issues with the lines no longer moving forward.

   -You can't bathe in there! The sink in the Break room now fills up with water.

If anyone happens to come across issues or simply have feedback for the game, whether it be new features you'd like to see, features you'd like to see revamped, or simply features that you think could use some balancing, your feedback is invaluable! Please shoot us an email at bugs@outthereent.com.

Being our very first shipped VR title, we're always striving to improve and push out updates as often as possible. This isn't just our game, this is your  game too, we're always listening!

Thank you to everyone's support and feedback, a big shot-out to all of the content creators/let's players/YouTubers for showing off our game and having fun!

notes.title: There are BUGS on this flight!
notes.content:
Finding bugs in your seat? In your complimentary crackers? Even in your drink?! Don’t worry, we’re on the job! We’ve sent in a squad of exterminators to squash those pesky bugs. We hope this new patch will improve your TSA Frisky experience!

If you do happen to find any bugs, let us know! Post in discussions or email us at bugs@outthereent.com! Your feedback helps us more than you can imagine and allows us to squash those bugs before they run rampant.

Stay Frisky!

Patch Notes:
-Fixed inability to move past AFK Airport: Shift 1
-Improved ability to grab objects
-Door handle now loads level on turn rather than release
-Fixed “Perfect Searches” count
-Fixed toolbelt resetting position after shifts
-Fixed physics collisions on passengers
-Fixed suitcase improperly registering as clean
-End-of-shift Trophy now displays “Grab to Exit” to avoid confusion
-Fixed airhorn inconsistently working
-Breakroom faucet functionality
-Drawer and cabinet handles highlight to indicate grab
-Fixed “force pull” with telegrabbing
-Fixed a few sounds

notes.title: ALL ABOARD THE HYPE PLANE! TSA Frisky is now LIVE!
notes.content:
Strap on those TSA-approved black leather oxfords and prepare yourself for your new job as a TSA agent! Experience the stress and drama that those blue-clad sky-shepherds must endure every single day. Protect the airways by confiscating contraband and denying passage to hooligans. Proper training simply isn’t in our budget, so remember to at least look efficient to avoid blacking out on the job.

Become a TSA agent today!

-HTC Vive
-Oculus Rift
-Windows MR

If you encounter any bugs, issues, or simply have feedback for the game we’d love to hear from you! Email us at: bugs@outthereent.com, we’ll do our best to respond within 24 hours and will patch all issues ASAP. Look out for additional patches and updates over the course of the next few days.

Note to Windows MR users:
As of now haptics will not function properly through SteamVR unless you have the latest Windows Insider Build. This is a known issue with Windows.
